channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Em SP, Tarcísio diz que confia nas urnas e Flávio precisa abandonar 'discussão que não leva a lugar nenhum'
item.description: São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas said he trusts electronic voting machines and urged Senator Flávio Bolsonaro to stop the unfounded fraud debate, calling it unproductive. He also addressed the U.S. 25% tariff on Brazilian exports, advocating for negotiations with the U.S. government and rejecting economic reciprocity laws, stating Brazil must defend its interests through dialogue, not retaliation.

item.title: Volta a circular fala de Caiado dizendo não precisar de bolsonaristas
item.description: A video from March 2020 resurfaced showing Goiás Governor Ronaldo Caiado confronting Bolsonarist protesters during the pandemic, stating he did not need their votes and prioritizing public health measures as a doctor. He was heckled by demonstrators but defended his stance on restricting gatherings to curb coronavirus spread, even opposing President Bolsonaro’s stance. The clip has resurfaced amid 2026 pre-campaign tensions, with Caiado as a PSD presidential pre-candidate and having criticized Flávio Bolsonaro’s recent diplomatic engagement.

item.title: Por que Lula recalculou a rota sobre tarifaço dos Estados Unidos
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva recalibrated his strategy in response to the 25% U.S. tariff after strong backlash from the productive sector, which criticized the political use of the trade dispute. The government abandoned confrontational rhetoric and shifted focus to negotiating with Washington, offering R$18.5 billion in credit lines for exporters and seeking alternative markets to mitigate tariff impacts.

item.title: Flávio golpista: o moderado é cabeça de bacalhau da “zelite” sem miolo
item.description: The article criticizes Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) for maintaining a coupist discourse and threatening the STF, repeating his father's lies about the Brazilian electoral system before foreign diplomats. He is portrayed as a 'centrist extremist' attempting to appear moderate but failing to convince, unlike Tarcísio de Freitas, seen as the true candidate of 'moderate Bolsonarismo'. The author suggests the Bolsonaro family would rather lose to Lula than support an outsider as successor, and that Flávio lost backing after financial scandal revelations.

item.title: Zema defende voto impresso como complemento à urna eletrônica
item.description: Romeu Zema advocated for the implementation of a printed receipt in electronic voting machines as a complement to enhance electoral reliability, proposing that a sample of machines produce a sealed physical record for later verification. He affirmed having been elected and re-elected via electronic voting and considers the current system reliable, but supports improvements. His remarks came in response to unfounded claims by Flávio Bolsonaro, who falsely alleged CIA documentation of vote manipulation in Venezuela’s 2010 elections and linked it to Brazilian voting machines, a claim debunked by the TSE in 2020.

item.title: O que Ronaldo Caiado tentou mostrar ao criticar Flávio e Eduardo Bolsonaro
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado criticized Flávio Bolsonaro for reviving the claim of electronic ballot fraud, arguing it wasted a chance to discuss economic development with foreign ambassadors. He also indirectly questioned Eduardo Bolsonaro’s green card, implying Brazilian politicians should prioritize national interests over personal ones, and used a Disney metaphor to mock him. Caiado aims to position himself as a moderate alternative to radical Bolsonarism, focusing on economic and institutional agendas.

item.title: UP lança Vivian Mendes ao governo de SP com chapa puro-sangue em convenção estadual em SP
item.description: The Popular Unity (UP) party held its state convention in São Paulo and officially nominated Vivian Mendes as its candidate for governor of São Paulo in 2026, with Marcelo Pereira as her running mate. The party also confirmed candidates for the Senate (Maira de Souza and Marcio Alves), Chamber of Deputies (including Ricardo Senese), and the State Legislative Assembly. Mendes, who previously ran for Senate in 2022 and was detained during a protest against the privatization of Sabesp in 2023, leads the party's 'pure-blood' ticket.

item.title: Mudança na TV: BandNews completa 25 anos com novidades na grade e cenário tecnológico
item.description: BandNews TV celebrated its 25th anniversary with a complete programming overhaul and the launch of a state-of-the-art studio at Grupo Bandeirantes' headquarters in Morumbi. The new schedule strengthens political, economic, and business coverage, featuring commentators like Luiz Felipe Pondé and Reinaldo Azevedo, and reshuffled newscasts aimed at deepening factual analysis ahead of the elections. The launch event was attended by Vice President Geraldo Alckmin, Governor Tarcísio de Freitas, and Mayor Ricardo Nunes.

item.title: TSE recomenda que tribunais eleitorais firmem parcerias com especialistas em IA
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) recommended that regional electoral courts establish technical cooperation agreements with institutions specializing in artificial intelligence, digital forensics, and content analysis. The measure aims to strengthen the technical capacity of the Electoral Justice in producing evidence in cases involving disinformation and synthetic content. The goal is to ensure greater effectiveness in combating information manipulation during the electoral process.

item.title: Tarifaço: Alckmin diz que Lei de Reprocidade 'está na mesa', mas que objetivo não é 'fazer guerra comercial, e sim resolver problema'
item.description: Vice President Geraldo Alckmin stated that while the Reciprocity Law is available as an instrument, the government's goal is not retaliation or a trade war, but to resolve the issue of U.S. tariffs on Brazilian products through negotiation. He emphasized Brazil’s pursuit of dialogue and new markets to avoid escalation. President Lula reinforced that Brazil remains at the negotiating table despite the lack of U.S. reciprocity and will not abandon diplomatic efforts to address the matter.

item.title: União Brasil lança candidatura de ACM Neto ao governo da Bahia
item.description: ACM Neto was launched as the União Brasil candidate for governor of Bahia, with Zé Cocá as his running mate and alliances with Republicanos, PL, Novo, Podemos, PMN and the Progressista, PSDB-Cidadania and Renovação Solidária federations. He reinforced support for Ronaldo Caiado in the first round of the presidential race, with potential backing for Flávio Bolsonaro in a possible runoff against Lula. ACM Neto accused the Jerônimo Rodrigues administration of losing control of public safety and sought to avoid nationalizing the debate, citing a technical tie with the incumbent governor in recent polls.

item.title: Cúpula do PL vê erro de Flávio ao repetir discurso de Bolsonaro sobre urnas e o orienta a abandonar o tema
item.description: The PL leadership advised Flávio Bolsonaro to stop discussing electronic voting machines, arguing that repeating his father Jair Bolsonaro’s 2022 strategy causes more political harm than benefit and undermines his attempt to project moderation. Party officials believe the topic fails to expand the electorate beyond the Bolsonarist base and recommend focusing on economy, security, inflation, jobs, and cost of living to appeal to undecided voters.

item.title: Caiado e Renan Santos criticam Flávio Bolsonaro por falas em reunião com embaixadores
item.description: Pre-candidate Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) and candidate Renan Santos (Missão) criticized Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) for his remarks on electronic voting machines made during a meeting with ambassadors, defending the integrity of Brazil's electoral system.

item.title: “Flávio é o único que tem condições de derrotar o Lula”, diz Moro
item.description: Senator Sergio Moro (PL) stated that Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) is the only right-wing figure capable of defeating President Lula (PT) in the 2026 elections. Moro emphasized that defeating Lula is a national necessity for the country. The comment was made on January 22nd in support of Flávio Bolsonaro’s pré-candidacy for governor of Paraná.

item.title: Com jogadores da Copa, veja escalação do Flamengo contra Chapecoense
item.description: Flamengo fielded a lineup featuring 2026 World Cup players Gonzalo Plata and Léo Pereira for their Brasileirão match against Chapecoense. Uruguayan midfielder Arrascaeta returns to the bench after a three-month injury layoff, while De La Cruz remains sidelined. With 34 points, Flamengo aims to close the gap on league leaders Palmeiras (44 points) with an away win.

item.title: Associação defende competência de policiais para proteger Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: The National Congress Police Association defended the competence of federal legislative police in protecting Flávio Bolsonaro after he dismissed Federal Police security. The association emphasized their continuous training, integrated intelligence, and nearly eight years of operational experience building trust with the protected authority, stating that institutional protection is a core specialization of their unit.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro emitiu duas notas fiscais de R$ 500 mil para empresa que tinha suspeito no caso Master como diretor
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro issued two invoices of R$ 500,000 each to companies linked to figures involved in the Master case, including Artur Figueiredo, former director of Trustee DTVM, and later canceled the invoices. He stated he only provided legal services to Contábil Corrêa and refused to work with Copenhagen, claiming the invoices were issued in error and canceled the same day. The case was revealed by Metrópoles and confirmed by g1, raising concerns about potential ties to financial fraud schemes at Banco Master.

item.title: LULA DESAFIA TRUMP E RUBIO / IMPACTOS DO TARIFAÇO / ELEIÇÕES 2026 📱
item.description: President Lula publicly challenged Donald Trump and Marco Rubio’s trade policies, criticizing the impacts of the new tariff surge on Brazilian exports, particularly in agribusiness and industry. He warned that such measures threaten Brazil’s economic sovereignty and could trigger retaliatory actions, while reaffirming his government’s commitment to dialogue and market diversification. The remarks come amid rising political tensions ahead of the 2026 elections, with Lula positioning himself as a defender of national independence against external pressures.

item.title: O que diz o relatório da CIA citado por Flávio sobre urnas na Venezuela
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro cited a CIA report at an event for ambassadors, but the document does not address Brazilian elections nor claim that the voting machines of Venezuela and Brazil are made by the same company, as he inferred. His interpretation is a distortion of the report’s actual content.

item.title: Roseana Sarney anuncia pré-candidatura ao Senado
item.description: Roseana Sarney announced her pre-candidacy for the Senate from Maranhão in the 2026 elections, highlighting her deep ties to the state's history and her return to politics after overcoming cancer. She stressed that she is not seeking to rehash past governance debates but to bring a strong voice for Maranhão to Brasília, focusing on dialogue, unity, and defending state interests. Sarney said the support from her family, faith, and voters during her recovery renewed her commitment to serving the people of Maranhão.

item.title: Ciro indica que PP não comporá chapa de Flávio Bolsonaro nem será oposição ao próximo governo eleito
item.description: PP national president Ciro Nogueira indicated the party will adopt neutrality in the 2026 presidential election, neither supporting Flávio Bolsonaro nor committing as opposition to the next government, regardless of the winner. The decision, described as irreversible by PP allies, aims to grant state-level freedom in forming local alliances to strengthen the União-PP federation’s congressional bench, reflecting the party’s ideological balance between the more left-leaning Northeast and the more right-leaning South and Southeast.

item.title: Tarcísio diz que Flávio Bolsonaro não tem "nada a ver" com tarifaço dos EUA
item.description: São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas stated that Flávio Bolsonaro has no connection to the 25% tariff imposed by the United States on Brazilian products, which could cause up to US$ 11 billion in losses to Brazilian exports. He emphasized that negotiations must continue and described the measure as a surprise, though anticipated, due to the USTR’s Section 301 investigation. Flávio Bolsonaro participated in the hearing that initiated the trade probe against Brazil.

item.title: Pré-candidatos Ronaldo Caiado e Renan Santos criticam fala de Flávio Bolsonaro a embaixadores sobre urnas eletrônicas
item.description: Pre-candidates Ronaldo Caiado and Renan Santos criticized Flávio Bolsonaro’s remarks to foreign ambassadors, in which he raised doubts about the integrity of electronic voting machines. They argued that using diplomatic forums to challenge the electoral system harms Brazil’s international image and distracts from the opposition’s real priorities. Flávio Bolsonaro’s comments were seen as a repetition of unfounded narratives already dismissed by electoral and judicial authorities.

item.title: PT pede remoção de posts de Flávio sobre urnas eletrônicas
item.description: The PT filed a representation with the TSE requesting the removal of posts by Flávio Bolsonaro and other Bolsonarist allies spreading disinformation about electronic voting machines, linking them to alleged fraud in Venezuela based on claims already refuted by the court. The party argues there is a coordinated effort to undermine the electoral system, similar to what led to Jair Bolsonaro’s 2023 ineligibility, and requests guidance for platforms to prevent the spread of such content.

item.title: PP e União Brasil apoiam candidato de Ratinho Jr no Paraná
item.description: State deputy Sandro Alex (PSD), former government secretary, received official support from the União Brasil and Progressistas (PP) federation to run for governor of Paraná in 2026. The endorsement, articulated as a continuation of Ratinho Júnior's (PSD) administration, ended months of uncertainty over the ruling coalition's candidate.

item.title: Zema propõe sistema de votação com voto impresso e eletrônico
item.description: Romeu Zema, former governor of Minas Gerais and presidential pre-candidate for the Novo party, advocated for a hybrid voting system combining electronic ballots with printed receipts for audit and greater transparency. He stated that while he considers the current electoral system reliable — having been elected and re-elected through it — measures to increase security and trust in the process are welcome, emphasizing the importance of a paper trail. Zema reacted to criticisms from Senator Flávio Bolsonaro against electronic voting, reaffirming his confidence in the current system while supporting improvements that enhance verifiability.

item.title: Os problemas sérios de afirmação nacional não estão na propaganda governista
item.description: The author criticizes Lula’s nationalist rhetoric on 'sovereignty' as superficial, tactical, and electorally driven, ignoring real threats to Brazilian sovereignty such as the state’s inability to control territory (e.g., organized crime in the Amazon), a weak defense industrial base, and structural impediments like high taxation, legal insecurity, and low productivity. True sovereignty, the text argues, stems from competitiveness, innovation, and international integration — exemplified by Brazil’s potential to surpass the U.S. as the world’s top agricultural exporter — not from tariff bravado or symbolic poses with foreign adversaries.

item.title: Brasil avalia novo processo na OMC por tarifa dos EUA
item.description: The Lula government is considering restarting the WTO dispute process against U.S. tariffs after the legal basis shifted from an economic emergency declaration to Section 301 of U.S. trade law, rendering prior 2025 consultations inapplicable. Officials seek to avoid U.S. claims that Brazil is misusing a procedure intended for a different measure, which could weaken the case. Although a favorable panel ruling would have limited practical effect due to the non-functional WTO appellate body, it would carry political weight and strengthen Brazil’s negotiating position by affirming that the U.S. measures violate international trade rules.

item.title: PT aciona o TSE contra Flávio Bolsonaro por declaração falsa sobre urnas
item.description: The Hope Brazil Federation (PT, PV and PCdoB) filed an electoral representation with the TSE against Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) and other PL lawmakers for spreading disinformation about Brazilian electronic voting machines, falsely linking them to Venezuelan machines investigated by the CIA. The action seeks removal of the content, a fine of R$30,000, and a ban on repeating the false association between Smartmatic and Brazil’s electoral system, as the CIA document pertains solely to Venezuela and makes no reference to Brazil.

item.title: Caso Banco Master: Documentos revelam emissão e cancelamento de notas no escritório de Flávio
item.description: Newly revealed documents show that the law office of Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) issued R$1.5 million in invoices to companies linked to Daniel Vorcaro, with two of the invoices later canceled. The case raises suspicions of irregular fiscal practices related to Banco Master.

item.title: Lula diz que Brasil não vai “ficar chorando” por tarifa dos EUA
item.description: President Lula stated that Brazil will not 'be crying' over the tariff imposed by the U.S. and must seek commercial alternatives, emphasizing openness to negotiations and the pursuit of new markets. He unveiled the third edition of the Plano Brasil Soberano, allocating R$ 18.5 billion in credit for affected companies, sourced from the National Treasury and BNDES, and affirmed Brazil’s capacity to overcome the challenge through international credibility.

item.title: PT e aliados acionam TSE contra Flávio por declarações sobre urnas
item.description: The Hope Brazil Federation (PT, PV, PCdoB) filed a complaint with the TSE against Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) for allegedly spreading false information about Brazil's electronic voting system during a meeting with foreign ambassadors. The action claims the statements constitute political abuse and electoral disinformation.

item.title: União Brasil e PP apoiam candidato de Ratinho Jr no Paraná após rompimento com Moro
item.description: The União Brasil and Progressistas federation announced support for Sandro Alex (PSD) as the successor to Governor Ratinho Júnior in Paraná, following a split with Sergio Moro, who moved to the PL. The alliance was confirmed in a meeting with state leaders, including Alexandre Curi and Maria Victoria, while Rafael Greca (MDB) awaited the decision. Nationally, the federation declared neutrality in the presidential race, disappointing Flávio Bolsonaro.

item.title: PT pede que Flávio seja multado por fala sobre urnas eletrônicas
item.description: The PT has asked the TSE to fine Flávio Bolsonaro, Eduardo Bolsonaro, Gustavo Gayer, and Júlia Zanatta R$30,000 each for spreading disinformation about electronic voting machines, falsely claiming Brazil uses equipment from the Venezuelan company Smartmatic. The party alleges these statements are part of a coordinated effort to undermine confidence in the electoral system and requests the removal of posts distorting a CIA report on Venezuela’s voting system.

item.title: Equipe de Lula se divide sobre ida a debates em 2026
item.description: Lula's campaign team is divided over his participation in the 2026 presidential debates, with no consensus reached, as he will ultimately decide. He will skip the first debate on August 16 at 8 p.m. on Band due to a campaign rally in São Bernardo do Campo at 10 a.m. the same day, at the venue where he began his union activism in the late 1970s. The strategy favors rallies with allies and grassroots campaigning, echoing 2006 when Lula avoided first-round debates due to overconfidence — a miscalculation that remains a political trauma.

item.title: “A diferença do Flávio para a Viviane Barci é apenas o valor do contrato”
item.description: Renan Santos, president of Missão, stated that the difference between Viviane Barci de Moraes, wife of Justice Alexandre de Moraes, and Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) is 'only the value' of their contract with Banco Master. The comment followed a Metrópoles report on the involved law firm.

item.title: PP evita aliança com Flávio Bolsonaro para eleição
item.description: Ciro Nogueira, national president of the Progressistas (PP), rejected Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL) request for a presidential coalition during a meeting in Brasília on Wednesday (22). Although the meeting took place, Ciro avoided publicly commenting on its content, maintaining the party's neutral stance. The decision reinforces PP's strategy of avoiding alignment with Bolsonarist candidates for the 2026 election.

item.title: A contenção dos Bolsonaros
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, the PL presidential candidate, repeated his father’s false claims about electronic voting machines during a meeting with ambassadors, sparking negative backlash. Although he attempted to soften the statement, the damage was already done, reinforcing election denial narratives. Folha de S.P. headline described the act as surgically spreading disinformation.

item.title: PT pede que TSE multe Flávio Bolsonaro por fala sobre urnas eletrônicas e retire post de Eduardo e aliados
item.description: The PT has asked the TSE to fine Flávio Bolsonaro R$30,000 for spreading disinformation about electronic voting machines, falsely claiming they originate from Smartmatic and are linked to Venezuelan fraud. The party also seeks the removal of posts by Eduardo Bolsonaro, Gustavo Gayer, and Júlia Zanatta questioning the electoral system, along with similar fines for them. The PT argues the CIA document cited makes no reference to Brazil and its use is a deliberate distortion to undermine trust in the electoral process.

item.title: Paulo Figueiredo diz que declaração de Bolsonaro à Maria do Rosário sobre estupro foi ‘genial’
item.description: Bolsonarista influencer Paulo Figueiredo, grandson of former dictator João Figueiredo, praised Jair Bolsonaro's 2014 statement that Maria do Rosário 'did not deserve to be raped', calling it 'genial' because 'everyone thought so'. He also mocked deputy Jandira Feghali, suggesting rape threats against her were akin to suicide threats due to her appearance. Figueiredo is under investigation by the STF for alleged involvement in the 2022 election coup attempt.

item.title: PT aciona o TSE contra Flávio Bolsonaro por fake news sobre as urnas
item.description: The PT-led federation (PT, PCdoB, PV) filed a complaint with the TSE against Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), former deputy Eduardo Bolsonaro, deputy Gustavo Gayer (PL-GO), and deputy Júlia Zanatta (PL-SC) for spreading false claims that Brazilian electronic voting machines originate from the Venezuelan company Smartmatic, allegedly involved in electoral fraud. The parties seek a R$30,000 fine for each, immediate removal of social media posts, a ban on repeating the allegations, and notification to digital platforms to block content linking Smartmatic to Brazil’s electoral system. TSE President Minister Nunes Marques was randomly assigned as the case rapporteur.

item.title: PT aciona TSE contra Flávio Bolsonaro por dados falsos sobre urnas e cita precedentes de Francischini e Jair Bolsonaro
item.description: The Brazil of Hope Federation (PT, PV, and PCdoB) filed a representation with the TSE against Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) and allies for spreading false information about Brazilian electronic voting machines, falsely linking them to the Venezuelan company Smartmatic based on a declassified CIA report about Venezuela. The action references prior sanctions against Francischini and Jair Bolsonaro for electoral disinformation and urges the TSE to recognize the conduct as an electoral crime and apply legal penalties.

item.title: Governo discute novas medidas aos setores afetados por tarifaço
item.description: The Lula government announced extra credit for companies affected by the 25% tariff imposed by the United States and is discussing additional measures to alleviate impacts on affected sectors. The initiative aims to mitigate the effects of the U.S. tariff on the Brazilian economy, particularly in export-dependent industries. Measures are under internal review and expected to be announced soon.

item.title: Crusoé: PT surfa em tarifaço e lança campanha “O Brasil não se entrega”
item.description: The PT launched the campaign 'Brazil does not surrender' on the same day the US tariff on Brazilian imports took effect, linking the measure to the Bolsonaro family and framing it as a defense of national sovereignty. The initiative seeks to leverage the trade context to reinforce a narrative of resistance against external policies perceived as harmful to the country.

item.title: Flávio emitiu notas fiscais para cobrar de empresas ligadas a Vorcaro
item.description: The law office of Flávio Bolsonaro issued three invoices of R$ 500,000 each to companies linked to Daniel Vorcaro's scheme, totaling R$ 1.5 million. Two invoices were canceled, but one remains active, tied to legal services for Contábil Correa. Flávio denies wrongdoing, stating the services were not rendered and that canceled invoices reflect this, while alleging illegal leaks of confidential information by government entities.

item.title: Arthur Lira diz que PP pode ter nome próprio ao governo de AL
item.description: Federal deputy and Senate pre-candidate Arthur Lira (PP-AL) stated that the União Progressista federation (Progressistas and União Brasil) may launch its own candidate for the Alagoas governorship if an alliance with former Maceió mayor João Henrique Caldas (JHC) fails to materialize. He emphasized that waiting for JHC’s decision remains the priority, but if no agreement is reached, the bloc will pursue a standalone candidacy to solidify its political positioning. Party conventions began on July 20 and must conclude by August 5.

item.title: Escritório de Flávio Bolsonaro foi contratado por empresa ligada a consultoria que recebeu repasses do Master, mostram documentos
item.description: The law office of Senator Flávio Bolsonaro received R$ 500,000 from Contábil Correa for legal advisory services, according to an April 2025 invoice. The accounting firm is linked to Copenhagen, a consultancy that received R$ 57.9 million from Banco Master between 2024 and 2025. Flávio denies wrongdoing, stating the relationship is legal and private, and that he canceled two invoices totaling R$ 1 million issued to Copenhagen.

item.title: Flávio reage à publicação de notas emitidas para empresas ligadas a Vorcaro: "Completamente legal e privado"
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro denied working for Copenhagen Consultancy, a firm linked to Daniel Vorcaro, stating that the issuance of invoices was legal and private. He acknowledged issuing three invoices in April 2025 — two for R$500,000 each to Copenhagen (later canceled) and one to Contábil Correa, whose partner is a Copenhagen director — without explaining why he issued them if he did not render services. The case raises suspicions of using invoices to move funds tied to Banco Master.

item.title: Declaração de Flávio Bolsonaro contra as urnas chega ao TSE
item.description: The TSE will analyze Flávio Bolsonaro's statements against electronic voting machines made to ambassadors, following a lawyer's petition questioning whether such statements constitute an implicit renunciation of his right to run for office. The Court has already denied the claim that Brazil purchased Smartmatic voting machines, and Minister Floriano Azevedo is the rapporteur. The PT is also considering legal action against the senator.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro emitiu e cancelou R$ 1 milhão em notas fiscais para empresa que operou com o Master
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) issued and canceled two invoices of R$ 500 thousand each, totaling R$ 1 million, for a company that received R$ 5.9 million from Banco Master. The invoices were canceled after issuance, raising concerns about potential financial irregularities.
